title: Drunk Mom Tries to Bite Cops After Crashing into School Bus
description:
Bodycams caught the moment a Florida mom was arrested after a suspected DUI crash involving a school bus in Boynton Beach. The suspected impaired driver, Megan Champion, 38, allegedly crashed into a school bus with an 11-year-old child in her car. The incident escalated as Champion reportedly nearly stumbled into traffic and tried to bite an officer during the arrest. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
